title: Equilibrium deformation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the spring compression at equilibrium using Δx₀ = (m_A + m_B)g/k.

title: Equilibrium height
description: Essential: Correctly computes the final height from the ground as h = l₀ - Δx₀.

title: Maximum acceleration derivation
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law to the combined system at the lowest point to find a_max = kA/(m_A + m_B).

title: Maximum normal force
description: Important: Correctly applies Newton's second law to block B alone to find N_max = m_B(g + a_max).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Converts all masses to kg and lengths to meters for consistent SI unit calculations.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for acceleration at the lowest point (e.g., g - a_max instead of g + a_max).

title: Mass confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses only the mass of one object instead of the combined mass when calculating equilibrium compression or acceleration.
